# Load Required Libraries

```{r setup}
library(dreamlet)
library(limma)
library(tidyverse)
library(BiocParallel)
library(Seurat)
library(scales)
```

## Load results
```{r}
dreamlet_results = qs2::qs_read("../shared objs and code/dreamlet_de_results_all_contrasts.qs2")
```


Remove genes within +/- 5mb of tg site
```{r}
#tg location from Goodwin et al, 2019 Supplementary info
transgene_location = 62978636
library(GenomicFeatures)
library(TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm39.knownGene)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)

# 2. Load the TxDb object
txdb <- TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm39.knownGene

# 3. Extract gene boundaries as a GRanges object
# By default, TxDb packages use Entrez IDs as their primary keys/names
mouse_genes <- genes(txdb)

# 4. Convert the GRanges object to a standard data frame
genes_df <- as.data.frame(mouse_genes)

# 5. Map Entrez IDs to Gene Symbols using org.Mm.eg.db
genes_df$symbol <- mapIds(
  org.Mm.eg.db,
  keys = genes_df$gene_id,
  column = "SYMBOL",
  keytype = "ENTREZID",
  multiVals = "first"
)


genes_df_chr3 = genes_df %>% filter(seqnames == "chr3")
genes_df_chr3 = genes_df_chr3 %>% mutate(
  distance = transgene_location - start)

genes_df_chr3 = genes_df_chr3 %>% 
  mutate(within_5_mb = 
           case_when(
             abs(distance) < 5e6 ~ T,
             .default = F
           ))

genes_df_chr3_within_dist = genes_df_chr3 %>% filter(within_5_mb == T)
dreamlet_results$possible_tg_artifact = dreamlet_results$gene %in% genes_df_chr3_within_dist$symbol
```


All DEG counts together
```{r}
# Count significant genes (FDR < 0.05) per cluster
sig_counts <- dreamlet_results %>%
  filter(!possible_tg_artifact) %>% #filter out genes within 5 mb 
  filter(comparison %in% c("early_amyloid_contrast_m", "early_amyloid_contrast_f","prolonged_amyloid_contrast_m", "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_f")) %>%
  mutate(sig = adj.P.Val < .05) %>% 
  group_by(cluster, comparison) %>%
  summarise(n_sig = sum(sig), .groups = "keep") %>%
  mutate(sex = case_when(
    comparison %in% c("prolonged_amyloid_contrast_m","early_amyloid_contrast_m") ~ "M",
    .default = "F"
  )) %>% mutate(
    comparison = case_when(
      comparison  =="prolonged_amyloid_contrast_m" ~ "Old 5X -- Old Ntg",
      comparison  =="prolonged_amyloid_contrast_f" ~ "Old 5X -- Old Ntg",
      comparison  =="early_amyloid_contrast_m" ~ "Young 5X -- Young Ntg",
      comparison  =="early_amyloid_contrast_f" ~ "Young 5X -- Young Ntg",
    )
  ) %>% mutate(
    sex = case_when(
      sex  =="M" ~ "Male",
      sex  =="F" ~ "Female")
  ) %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = sex, values_from = n_sig)


#columns: 
#color by comparison (Old 5X vs Old Ntg, Young 5X vs Young Ntg), Male (X-axis), Female (Y-axis)

library(ggrepel)
sig_counts$True_Male = sig_counts$Male
sig_counts$True_Female = sig_counts$Female
#get clusts where > 10 in any comparison males or females
clusts_to_keep = sig_counts %>% filter(Male >= 10 | Female >= 10) %>% pull(cluster) %>% unique
sig_counts = sig_counts %>% filter(cluster %in% clusts_to_keep)
sig_counts =sig_counts %>% mutate(label = paste0(" (", True_Male, "M, ", True_Female, "F)"),
  .default = NA
)
sig_counts$comparison = factor(sig_counts$comparison, levels = c("Young 5X -- Young Ntg","Old 5X -- Old Ntg"))
```



```{r}
library(grid)
library(scales)

brks <- c(0, 2^(0:10))   # 0, 1, 2, 4, ... 1024

sig_counts$comparison = factor(sig_counts$comparison,
  levels = c("Young 5X -- Young Ntg","Old 5X -- Old Ntg"))

plot_sig_counts = ggplot(sig_counts, aes(x = log2(Male + 1), y = log2(Female + 1), color = cluster)) +
  geom_path(
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(.2, "cm"), type = "closed", angle = 25),
    linewidth = .5,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = label), color = "black", max.overlaps = 10,
    box.padding = 0.5, point.padding = 0.5, nudge_y = 0.1, nudge_x = 0.1,
    force = 5, segment.size = 0.3, size = 5
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(alpha = comparison)) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(.3, .8), name = "Comparison") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = log2(brks + 1), labels = comma(brks),
    limits = c(-0.5, 10.2)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = log2(brks + 1), labels = comma(brks),
    limits = c(-0.5, 10.2)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Significant DE Genes per Cluster",
    x = expression(bold("Number of DE Genes, Males (log"[2]*" + 1 scale)")),
    y = expression(bold("Number of DE Genes, Females (log"[2]*" + 1 scale)")),
    color = "Cluster"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text  = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

ggsave("Combined DEG counts males females.pdf", plot_sig_counts, width = 8, height = 6)
```




Plot expression of the medial MB marker Foxb1 and lateral MB marker Kcnc2 to identify which clusters exhibit high MB expression
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(BPCells)
library(khroma)

#plot neuronal/non-neuronal discriminatory gene dotplot separately, then together
neuron_assignments = readRDS(file = "../shared objs and code/neuronal_number_ids_cluster_assignments.rds")
df_internal_and_official_name = read_csv("../shared objs and code/internal_to_official_name_conversions_neuronal.csv")
neuron_names = names(neuron_assignments)
neuron_assignments = df_internal_and_official_name$official_name[match(neuron_assignments, df_internal_and_official_name$numeric_id)]
names(neuron_assignments) = neuron_names
neuronal_ge = open_matrix_dir("../shared objs and code/post_qc_decontx_counts/")
neuronal_ge = neuronal_ge[,names(neuron_assignments)]
log_norm_neuronal_ge =   multiply_cols(neuronal_ge, 1/Matrix::colSums(neuronal_ge))
log_norm_neuronal_ge <- log1p(log_norm_neuronal_ge * 1e6) # Log cpm
all_neuronal_log_norm = pseudobulk_matrix(log_norm_neuronal_ge, cell_groups = neuron_assignments, method = "mean", threads = 10L)
all_neuronal_percent = pseudobulk_matrix(neuronal_ge > 0, cell_groups = neuron_assignments, method = "mean", threads = 10L)
```


```{r}
all_neuronal_percent_df = all_neuronal_percent %>% as.data.frame()
all_neuronal_percent_df = all_neuronal_percent_df %>% rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "cluster", values_to = "percent_exp")

all_neuronal_exp_df = all_neuronal_log_norm %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "cluster", values_to = "avg_exp")

# Join percent expressing and average expression
dotplot_df = left_join(all_neuronal_exp_df, all_neuronal_percent_df,
                       by = c("gene", "cluster"))


```

Foxb1 and Rprm (medial MB)
```{r}
genes_to_plot = c("Foxb1", "Rprm")

two_gene_df = dotplot_df %>%
  filter(gene %in% genes_to_plot) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  mutate(z_exp = as.numeric(scale(avg_exp))) %>%
  ungroup()

# Top 10 clusters by Foxb1 expression
top10_clusters = two_gene_df %>%
  filter(gene == "Foxb1") %>%
  slice_max(avg_exp, n = 10) %>%
  arrange(avg_exp) %>%          # ascending so highest ends up at the top of the y-axis
  pull(cluster)

# Subset both genes to those clusters and set plotting order
two_gene_df_10 = two_gene_df %>%
  filter(cluster %in% top10_clusters) %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = factor(cluster, levels = top10_clusters),
    gene    = factor(gene, levels = genes_to_plot)
  )



plot_foxb1_rprm = ggplot(two_gene_df_10,
                         aes(x = gene, y = cluster, size = percent_exp, fill = z_exp)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      mid = "white", high = "#D55E00", low = "#0072B2",
      name = "Mean Log\nExpression"
    ) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Cluster",
    size = "Percent\nExpressing",
    fill = "Scaled Log-\nNormalized Expression"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold.italic"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
ggsave("foxb1_rprm_dotplot_neuronal_clusters.pdf", plot_foxb1_rprm, width = 6, height = 8)

```


Kcnc2 (lateral MB) - check - they don't express kcnc2 (didn't put in paper but a good check regardless)
```{r}
# Filter for kcnc2
kcnc2_df = dotplot_df %>% filter(gene == "Kcnc2") %>%
  mutate(cluster = fct_reorder(cluster, avg_exp, .desc = FALSE))

kcnc2_df$z_exp = scale(kcnc2_df$avg_exp)
#subset to top 10 for vis
kcnc2_df_10 = kcnc2_df %>% arrange(desc(avg_exp)) %>% slice_max(avg_exp, n = 10)
# Dot plot
plot_kcnc2 = ggplot(kcnc2_df_10, aes(x = gene, y = cluster, size = percent_exp, fill = z_exp)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.3) +
  labs(
    title = "kcnc2 Expression Across Neuronal Clusters",
    x = "",
    y = "Cluster",
    fill = "Scaled Log-\nNormalized Expression"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

ggsave("kcnc2_dotplot_neuronal_clusters.pdf", plot_kcnc2, width = 6, height = 8)
#supplementary figure to establish mammilary body location
```

sig_results_glp1r_lepr = dreamlet_results %>% filter(cluster == "44_Glp1r_Lepr", comparison == "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_f") %>% filter(adj.P.Val < .05) %>% arrange(adj.P.Val)

write_csv(x = sig_results_glp1r_lepr, "sig_results_glp1r_lepr_females.csv")

Plot jak2 pathway sig results in glp1r/lepr in females
```{r}
library(qs2)
library(dreamlet)
library(ggsignif)
processed_dreamlet = qs2::qs_read("../shared objs and code/processed_dreamlet.qs2")
intermediate_dreamlet = readRDS("../shared objs and code/intermediate_dreamlet_obj.rds")
```


```{r}
glp1r_lepr_jak2_pathway_hits_data = extractData(intermediate_dreamlet, assay = "44_Glp1r_Lepr", genes = c("Stat3", "Sbno2","Asb4"))

glp1r_lepr_jak2_pathway_hits_data_tidy = glp1r_lepr_jak2_pathway_hits_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("Stat3","Sbno2","Asb4"), names_to = "gene", values_to = "log_expression")

glp1r_lepr_jak2_pathway_hits_data_tidy$gene = factor(
  glp1r_lepr_jak2_pathway_hits_data_tidy$gene, levels = c("Stat3","Sbno2","Asb4")
)


color_mapping_strains_to_colors <- c(
"B6xBXD14" = "#77AADD",
"B6xBXD77" = "#EE8866",
"B6xBXD2Gpnmb" = "#EEDD88",
"B6xBXD39" = "#FFAABB",
"B6xBXD19" = "#99DDFF",
"B6xBXD169" = "#44BB99",
"B6xBXD28" = "#BBCC33",
"B6xBXD12" = "#AAAA00",
"B6xBXD73" = "#DDDDDD",
"B6" = "#000000" # Black
)

color_ntg_5xfad <- c("Ntg" = "#a1bad4", "5XFAD" = "#f6b2ba")

# --- significance annotations from dreamlet results ---
jak_sig_labels <- dreamlet_results %>%
  filter(cluster == "44_Glp1r_Lepr",
         comparison == "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_f",
         gene %in% c("Stat3", "Sbno2", "Asb4")) %>%
  mutate(
    annotations = case_when(
      adj.P.Val < 0.001 ~ "***",
      adj.P.Val < 0.01  ~ "**",
      adj.P.Val < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE               ~ ""
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, annotations) %>%
  mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = c("Stat3", "Sbno2", "Asb4")))

jak_plot_data <- glp1r_lepr_jak2_pathway_hits_data_tidy %>%
  filter(age_genotype %in% c("old_Ntg", "old_5XFAD") & sex == "Female")

jak_star_df <- jak_plot_data %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(ymax   = max(log_expression, na.rm = TRUE),
            yrange = diff(range(log_expression, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(jak_sig_labels, by = "gene") %>%
  mutate(
    xmin       = 1,
    xmax       = 2,
    y_position = ymax + yrange * 0.08
  )

# --- plot ---
glp1r_lepr_jak2_plot = ggplot(
  jak_plot_data,
  aes(x = genotype, y = log_expression, fill = genotype)
) +
  facet_wrap(~ gene, scales = "free_y") +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE) +
  geom_jitter(width = .1, aes(color = strain), size = 2) +
  geom_signif(
    data        = jak_star_df,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax,
        annotations = annotations,
        y_position  = y_position),
    manual      = TRUE,
    textsize    = 5,
    vjust       = .3,
    tip_length  = 0.02,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Strain", values = color_mapping_strains_to_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Genotype", values = color_ntg_5xfad) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Ntg" = "Ntg", "5XFAD" = "5XFAD")) +
  labs(,
    x = NULL,
    y = "Log Normalized Expression"
  ) +
  guides(color = "none", fill = "none") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold.italic", size = 11),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = NA),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines")
  )

ggsave("glp1r_lepr_jak2_pathway_females.pdf", glp1r_lepr_jak2_plot, width = 9, height = 4)
```
